## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit (`feat(order): …`, `fix: …`)
- [ ] A migration, if any, works with the app versions already on phones
- [ ] New personal data or permissions are in `docs/privacy/data-inventory.md`, the privacy policy and the store declarations
- [ ] Every new control has a label, works with a keyboard and a screen reader, and is at least 44 pt
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under Unreleased if users will notice
